description: Shared wire definitions for GainForest feed procedures. The feeds return references and selection metadata only. They never return record content; callers hydrate the referenced records themselves.

activityFeed.description: Identifies the GainForest activity feed algorithm.

activityFeedParams.description: Parameters accepted by the GainForest activity feed. A request that omits params gets the default filter, all. The feed is the same for every caller, and properties not defined here are ignored.

filter.description: Which kind of activity to include. Reposts appear only when the filter is all.

followingFeed.description: Identifies the GainForest following feed algorithm: the activity feed restricted to what the accounts a viewer follows have published.

followingFeedParams.description: Parameters accepted by the GainForest following feed. The feed holds the records of the accounts the viewer follows, through valid app.certified.graph.follow records, selected like the activity feed: the same kinds, grouping, and cursor. A recording belongs to the owner of its recorder folder, so a follower of that owner sees the recordings other accounts stored in the owner's folders (the folder's app.gainforest.ac.deployment record must exist and be valid), and a recording a followed account stored in a folder someone else owns is left out. A viewer who follows more than 500 accounts gets the 500 most recently followed. The viewer is the account that sent an authenticated request; an anonymous request must name one with viewerDid. Properties not defined here are ignored.

filter.description: Which kind of activity to include. Reposts appear only when the filter is all.

viewerDid.description: The account whose follows scope the feed. Optional when the request is authenticated: the authenticated service caller is the viewer, and a value that names anyone else is rejected. Required for an anonymous request.

recordItem.description: Reference to one project, observation, organization, post, or audio recording. It carries no record content. An observation or a recording appears as a recordItem when it is not part of a groupItem: a group of fewer than 3 rows is returned as separate recordItems, and bioacoustic sightings are never grouped.

kind.description: Which kind of record the uri points at.

cid.description: CID of the selected record version at selection time. Omitted when Hyperindex has not stored one.

createdAt.description: The record's own createdAt, which orders the feed.

repostItem.description: Reference to an app.gainforest.feed.repost record and the record it reposts. It carries no record content.

cid.description: CID of the repost record at selection time. Omitted when Hyperindex has not stored one.

createdAt.description: The repost's own createdAt, which orders the feed.

subject.description: AT-URI of the reposted post, observation, or project.

groupItem.description: One card that groups at least 3 rows of one kind: observations by one account, or recordings in one recorder folder. The page folds every row of the group into the card as long as it is no more than 12 hours older than the group's previous row, whatever other rows lie between them, and places the card at its newest row. Bioacoustic sightings, reposts, posts, projects, and organizations are never grouped, and a group of fewer than 3 rows is returned as separate recordItems. A group can continue on a later page. Keep the last card shown for each groupKey; when a later card has the same groupKey and its `to` is no more than 12 hours before that card's `from`, merge it into that card: add `total`, take the later card's `from` and `more`, and append `subjects`. Only a sample of the card is referenced.

kind.description: What the card groups: observations by one account, or audio recordings in one recorder folder.

did.description: Account that owns every observation in the card, or owner of the recorder folder: the account in the folder's AT-URI, or the recording's own account when it has no folder.

deployment.description: AT-URI of the app.gainforest.ac.deployment folder the recordings belong to. Only on audio cards. Omitted for recordings without a folder and when the recordings' deploymentRef is not a valid AT-URI.

groupKey.description: Opaque, stable hash of the card's kind, owner, and folder. It names the group, not the card: it is the same on every page and in every request, and two cards of one group, such as the cards a gap of more than 12 hours splits it into, carry the same groupKey.

total.description: Number of rows in this card.

from.description: createdAt of the oldest row in this card.

to.description: createdAt of the newest row in this card. This orders the card in the feed.

subjects.description: AT-URIs of up to 20 rows of this card, newest first.

more.description: True when the request's row budget (5,000 rows) ended the page while this card could still be continued: it is the group's latest card and the page's last row is within 12 hours of its oldest row, so a later row can join it. Omitted otherwise. Its absence does not mean the group is complete: a group also continues after a page that ended for another reason, so always merge cards by groupKey and the 12-hour rule.
